note: Real outputs saved from the Ghar hackathon demo session (11 Jul 2026). Tours: gemini-omni-flash-preview. Plans and image edits: gemini-3.1-flash-image. Whole-home brief: gemini-3.5-flash with Google Search grounding. Videos re-encoded for the web; nothing else was changed.

examples.title: Dream 3BHK, modern techy
examples.summary: 3BHK with a living room and dining table, a home gym and underground parking, in a modern techy style. The tour, the concept floor plan and the full architect build pack all come from this home.

tours.caption: Walkthrough from the LED-lit living and dining room into the home gym.

plans.caption: Ground floor (living, dining, kitchen, master and second bedrooms, home gym) plus the underground parking level.

examples.briefCaption: Whole-home architect brief: room-by-room specs, grounded budget, materials and the society approvals checklist.

examples.title: Family 2BHK, cane & block-print
examples.summary: A family home in a contemporary Indian style: a themed kids' bedroom, a warm wooden kitchen and a reading nook with a cane chair and block-print cushions. It includes repeat tours, an evening version of the nook, and two concept plans.

tours.caption: Four separate renders of the same locked kids' room design.
The kitchen on its own, then a longer walk from the kitchen through the living room into a bedroom.
A daytime walkthrough, then the same nook at dusk with the lamps on.

plans.caption: 2BHK concept plan: master bedroom with WFH desk, kids' room with toy storage, modular kitchen, cane sofa set, balcony.
A second plan render from the session: a 3-bedroom layout with a kids' room, a dining corner and a WFH corner.

examples.title: Fix my corner, then evening & monsoon
examples.summary: The refurbish flow: one edit swaps in a rattan armchair, then Omni Flash animates the corner at golden hour and re-edits that clip into a monsoon evening.

input.caption: Input: a synthetic test drawing of the booth corner, not a real photo. It was used to test the pipeline.

edits.caption: Edit: “replace the chair with a rattan armchair” (gemini-3.1-flash-image).

tours.caption: Image-to-video from the edited corner: evening light moves across the floor.
The golden-hour clip fed back to Omni as a video edit: rain outside, lamps on inside.
